approved_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: run all three options and compare; generalization later
question: If the redundant level core is collapsed to 1-3 averaged virtual channels before fusion, does continuous L-SML over [core virtuals + 30 independent channels] stop failing (as it did when independent channels were added to the full bank) and add value over plain averaging of the same inputs?
motivation: tail_label_share_v1: covariance ranks independent channels by quality (Spearman .64 PRMB / .87 PB) but the nuisance-inflated core compresses their scale, e.g. hist_energy_cusum_abs accuracy .132 with core correlation .045, 65% label-driven.
channels: 48 = 52-column pool minus exact duplicates (ct7_ve1, hist_entropy_series, hist_spilled_series) and constant hist_trace_length_series. Per-answer z-scored, native sign. Level family = |r_level_marginal| >= 0.45 (18 channels, POOL_STRUCTURE.csv, label-free). Independent = the other 30.
virtual_construction: plain mean of the member channels' per-answer z-scores, then re-z-scored within answer. Membership fixed from label-free correlation structure (PCA/|r| clustering on pooled PRMBench steps). Note: the count 1-3 was motivated partly by a label-using diagnostic, so all three options are frozen and reported together; none is selected afterwards as 'the method'.

arms.X_lsml: continuous L-SML (fit_fusion_weights mode=continuous, anchor = level virtual) on [virtuals + 30 independent], X in A,B,C
arms.X_equal: equal weights on the same reduced inputs (tests whether L-SML adds value)
arms.all48_lsml: continuous L-SML on all 48 (known failure mode), anchor q15_H1
arms.B11_lsml / B11_equal: bank11 references refitted on the same folds

folds: FOLDS as in OOF_ANSWERS: evaluation fold k, calibration fold (k+1)%5, fit on the other three (same as declared_joint_prmbench_v1)

endpoints.primary: PRMBench within-answer AUC and PRMScore (answer-z, threshold = 0.8 quantile of calibration-fold scores)
endpoints.secondary: ProcessBench macro8 step-level accuracy of the earliest argmax on erroneous answers

contrasts: paired source-group bootstrap, 20000 draws, seed 20260924: X_lsml - X_equal, X_lsml - all48_lsml, X_lsml - B11_lsml, X_lsml - ct7 for X in A,B,C; all48_lsml - all48_equal. 95% intervals, no multiplicity claim of a winner.
not_in_scope: generalization to external benchmarks (later, per Omri); any selection among A/B/C.
